title: ArGen: Auto-Regulation of Generative AI via GRPO and Policy-as-Code
reasoning: The paper's core case study focuses on aligning an LLM with Dharmic ethical principles (such as Ahimsa and Dharma) derived from the Bhagavad Gita. These faith-based and ethical concepts are operationalized as the central metrics for the framework's reward system and policy enforcement, rather than being discussed only in a secondary ethics section.
